concerns.text: Task T003 generates deterministic *structural* latent vectors, but FR‑001 in the specification requires generation of *visual layout latents* using a frozen visual encoder. The task therefore weakens the functional requirement by substituting a different kind of latent without a corresponding spec amendment.

Task T004 (and downstream tasks) assume the augmented representation concatenates text embeddings with the *structural* latent (see T008‑T010), whereas FR‑004 explicitly mandates concatenation with *predicted visual latents*. This constitutes a retroactive narrowing of the requirement.

SC‑002 in the specification calls for measuring *accuracy/F1* of the augmented model. The downstream tasks (T008‑T010) only refer to a generic “metric” field in results.json and do not guarantee that the metric reported is accuracy or F1, leaving the success criterion unmeasurable.
